presentation.label: TEMPO
presentation.summary: Maps project/global tempo to a new LFO PMTR destination, TEMPO, so LFOs can address BPM.
presentation.overview: Tempo LFO exposes the stock project tempo (BPM × 24 at 0x8000181c, 30–300 BPM) as LFO SETUP PMTR = TEMPO (index 39). Any audio-track LFO can then modulate global tempo with stock depth, waves, locks and scenes. The TEMPO key / LEVEL tempo edit remains the base editor; when an LFO writes TEMPO, the module publishes the mapped BPM into the same project word REPITCH and the frame builder already follow. Index 39 follows the coordinated map 30 PROB … 38 TSTR / 39 TEMPO. This tip does not own track speed (TSPD exists) and does not claim SPOS or Play Modes remapper sites.
highlights: Base edit stays the TEMPO key / LEVEL tempo
Does not own TSPD or SPOS / Play Modes remappers
usage: Set a clear project tempo so BPM changes are audible.
In LFO SETUP set PMTR to TEMPO and raise DEP to modulate global tempo.

access.location: TEMPO key for the base; LFO SETUP → PMTR = TEMPO for modulation
steps: Select an audio track with a clear rhythm.
Hold the TEMPO key and set a known BPM (for example 120).
Hold FUNC and press LFO; set PMTR to TEMPO and adjust DEP / WAVE / TRIG.

controls.name: TEMPO
controls.doc: Project/global tempo published for LFO PMTR TEMPO. High byte 0–127 maps onto 30–300 BPM (stock PROJECT_BPM24). Base edited with the TEMPO key; LFO writes the live shadow word.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial
steps: Include Tempo LFO in a build; set a known project tempo (for example 120 BPM) on an audio track with a clear rhythm.
Hold FUNC+LFO; set PMTR=TEMPO, raise DEP, pick WAVE/TRIG; press PLAY and watch project BPM move.
Set DEP to 0 or change PMTR away from TEMPO; re-edit with the TEMPO key.
